x: Announcement4 September 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com Starfall: Discovery | Patch Preview The newest installment in the Starfall Saga is landing soon in ArcheAge Classic. Starfall: Discovery will expand the story around the comet that has been looming over Erenor Discovery (1.3.6) — Global Patch Preview The comet has already changed Erenor. Discovery is the patch that starts answering what it left behind: restless beasts, a new hybrid weapon, Anthalon chasing fragments across Auroria, and Ayanad accessories that can finally be unsealed. This post is the rolled-up preview of the Discovery series. Full numbers and tooltips remain in the individual articles. 1.3.6 Preview — Enlightened Ayanad Accessories 1.3.6 Preview — Primal Anthalon 1.3.6 Preview — Scythes 1.3.6 Preview — Taming 1.3.6 Preview — Enlightened Skills Patch Notes — August 28, 2026 (release date) Patch 1.3.6 releases on September 11th. New Proficiency: Taming Taming is ArcheAge Classic's first custom profession. In the months since the comet passed, herders and hunters have been telling the same story. Beasts that once kept to the deep brush have started coming into the open. Boars on the pastures of Solzreed. Grubs along the cold ridgelines of Karkasse. Ants and stranger things dragging themselves out of heat-cracked desert washes after dusk. Tameable creatures can appear as wild stragglers around Erenor, either through farming mobs marked with the Beast of the Wild buff, or found separated from their pack as a Wild beast. How taming works Equipping a Greenhorn’s Backpack will grant skills that enable you to temper a tameable beast's mood. Soothe it when it is scared. Using the wrong action at the wrong time and the beast will grow wary, lose trust, and can flee. Higher-quality backpacks make the process easier. Tamed beasts are a random grade, species, and personality. Grade — base movement speed Species — appearance and default skill set Personality — skills 3, 4, and 5, rolled against the species’ default Completing a successful tame will net you a Mysterious Beast box, which can be listed on the Auction House, where the buyer will have to gamble on personalities. There are four personalities: Hasty, Ferocious, Resolute, and Spunky. Stablehands now sell a Wildcaller Flute. Using one on a mount returns it to the wild and yields Whistles of the Wild. Whistles, armor, and consumables Whistles of the Wild craft taming equipment, mount armor, and a new consumable line that mixes into existing economies: Speed snacks for a short mount boost Food that restores mount Health and Mana Emergency potions for a burst of companion Mana Meals that increase Combat Pet capability On-the-go mount resurrection Mount armor is worn in three pieces — shaffron, saddle, and cannonguards — across three tiers: base, Regal, and Ornate. Four paths exist: Path Role Swift Shorter mount cooldowns Stout Mount damage reduction Survey Increased movement speed while overencumbered Support Increased mana regeneration aura Taming armor can be regraded like other gear and gains gem slots at higher grade. A full Ornate set filled with Celerity gems is intended to be the fastest mount. Mix and match species and personalities to fit your playstyle. Exact recipes and additional costs will be revealed when the patch is live. New Weapon Type: Scythes Discovery adds a brand-new weapon type: Scythes. This is a two-handed weapon that puts Melee Attack, Magic Attack, and Healing Power on a single item. Hybrid archetypes have always been boxed in. Healing and magic together was effectively impossible. Two-handed melee with real magic attack did not exist. Healing melee was locked to shortspears. Scythes are built to open those combinations. They do not match a dedicated two-hander on raw power. Officially, scythes are about 11% weaker than their non-hybrid counterparts. That tax is the cost of flexibility, plus three weapon procs. Availability on release The initial release is limited to crafted and Hasla Emerald versions. Craft from Illustrious through Ayanad on 1.3.6 launch A Hasla Emerald Scythe exists for new, returning, or curious players and uses an Infused Emerald like any other emerald weapon There is no conversion of existing weapons into scythes Recipes use materials in line with other two-handed weapons (staves, greatclubs, greatswords). Exact recipes go live with the patch Obsidian, dungeon, and world-boss scythes are not in 1.3.6. Those paths — including the possibility of 1H variant — are planned after Discovery. Whether they land before or after 2.0 depends on that development cycle. They are a near-term priority, not a launch feature. Stat distributions Crafted scythes are available in: Autumn (Str, Int, Spi) Meteor (Str, Spi) Sunset (Str, Int) Meadow (Int, Spi) Wave (Int) Flame (Str) Life (Spi) Example — Epic Ayanad Autumn Scythe, no temper: DPS: 670 Magic Attack: 670 Healing Power: 670 Strength +53 / Intelligence +44 / Spirit +35 Gear Score: 1010 The three procs Melee and magic procs fire when you deal that damage type. The healing proc fires when you heal an ally. Important note: All procs are on cooldown for 8 seconds after equipping a scythe. Lifesteal — on melee damageHeal yourself for (50 + 180% Healing Power). Influenced by healing critical rate, critical bonus, and percentage increases. Chance on hit: 20% Cooldown: 30 seconds Timewarp — on magic damageFully resets the cooldown of certain skills. Can proc from any magic damage, including damage-over-time. Cooldown reduction does not affect this proc's cooldown. Chance on hit: 5% Cooldown: 180 seconds Here is a full list of all spells that are affected by Timewarp: Spell Boastful Roar Comet’s Boon Crushing Grasp Abyssal Wave Vicious Implosion Mana Force Hell Spears Absorb Lifeforce Summon Crows Crippling Mire Summon Wraith Cursed Thorns Critical Discord Dissonance Earthen Grip Enervate Focal Concussion Fiend’s Knell Flamebolt Freezing Arrow Arc Lightning Freezing Earth Searing Rain Chain Lightning Flame Barrier Serpent Strike Meteor Strike Gods’ Whip (All Ancestral and Enlightened variants of the spells listed above are also affected by Timewarp.) Nui’s Celerity — on healRemoves the cast time from certain skills. Can proc from heal over-time skills. Chance on heal: 8% Cooldown: 50 seconds Duration: 8 seconds Here is a full list of all spells that are affected by Nui’s Celerity: Skill Mend Holy Bolt Revive Skewer Renewal Rhythmic Renewal Antithesis Whirlwind’s Blessing Critical Discord Hummingbird Ditty Health Lift (All Ancestral and Enlightened variants of the spells listed above are also affected by Nui’s Celerity.) | Hybrid Gems In addition to touching up scythe procs, we have also added brand new hybrid gems for 2H weapons. Gale Lunagem: Harmony Lucid (T3): Melee, Magic Critical Damage & Healing Critical Bonus +3.5%. Vivid (T2): Melee, Magic Critical Damage & Healing Critical Bonus +2.1%. Clear (T1): Melee, Magic Critical Damage & Healing Critical Bonus +1.4%. Obtaining: Added to sealed lunagems obtained from Mistsong Summit’s Mistsong Reticules, or those from crafting up lower tier sealed lunagems acquired from Mistsong Summit. Lucid version added to the loyalty shop for 100 loyalty. Extra Notes: Function like normal critical damage/healing critical bonus gems. Same socketing rates and socketing gold cost. Not restricted to only scythes. After launch, scythe performance will be observed and adjusted as necessary so hybrid archetypes stay viable. New World Boss: Primal Anthalon Primal Anthalon, Leader of the Crimson Army, arrives in Discovery as a new world-boss challenge. As the comet passed over Sungold Fields, Anthalon watched its trail and felt the power inside it. Knowing it would descend on Exeloch, he followed, determined to claim the fragments before they fell into mortal hands. He means to harness that power and turn it on Auroria. That is the Discovery beat. The comet is not only scenery. Anthalon is the first named power to find a use for it. Further comet lore — including follow-up work with Iseren of the Ayanad Council — is intended to continue after launch. Primal Kyrios set Primal Anthalon has a chance to drop one random piece of the Primal Kyrios cloth set, which has an equivalent ilvl to Ayanad armor. The set carries Anthalon's signature spell, Absorb Mind. Upon dealing any damage, the user has a 5% chance to trigger Absorb Mind. Similar to Anthalon’s Necromantic Flame, Absorb Mind grants the user a new ability that allows them teleport to any target within 20 meters, after which, the user has a 5 second window to activate Mind Grasp which will pick the closest 10 enemy units in a 15 meter range and lift them up into the air. Victims of Mind Grasp are helpless but are immune to any damage for the duration of the lift. This means, although you are unable to hurt enemies lifted by Mind Grasp, you have ample time to prepare for their inevitable descent. Absorb Mind (player set) Value Mind Grasp Range 15 meters Teleport Range 20 meters Number of Targets 10 Differences from Anthalon's original spell: There is no way to break free from Absorb Mind. Enemy players affected by Absorb Mind are immune to all damage while levitated. The original mana burn is not included. The trip on landing is not included. The caster is immune to all CC while channeling Mind Grasp. Pure Destruction set effects: 4 pieces: +700 Toughness. Low chance to trigger Anthalon's Necromantic Flame when receiving damage 7 pieces: −4.5% received damage. Low chance to trigger Absorb Mind when dealing damage Primal Hallow A Primal Hallow is a guaranteed drop from Primal Anthalon. Use it to upgrade a piece of existing Anthalon armor into the Primal equivalent. Grade is retained. Additional craft costs will be revealed when the patch is live. New Gear: Enlightened Ayanad Accessories Scholars of the Ayanad Library recovered research into Runestones — work Alexander pursued, then destroyed when Kyrios wanted it. A Runestone resonates with the magic already sealed in an item and draws that power to the surface. Apply a Runestone to an Ayanad accessory and it becomes the matching Enlightened version. Grade is kept. Existing equip effects stay. The process does not replace the accessory; it awakens it. By default, Enlightened accessories have no assigned stats until you frost them. Three enchant types Perfect Lunasigil — stats on an Enlightened ring, earring, or necklace (example: Perfect Stone Lunasigil, +20 Stamina / +20 Spirit). Applying another Lunasigil replaces the current one Charm — applied to your costume. Grants the Enlightenment 2-set you unlocked Mark — Radiant or Hollow Lunamark on an Enlightened necklace. Rewrites one skill Rings and earrings A matching ring + earring pair of the same Ayanad type activates that Enlightenment (Meadow, Earth, Wave, Flame, Life, Lightning, Gale, and so on). Enchant the corresponding Charm on your costume to receive the effect. Two rings or two earrings of the same type do not activate the set. Necklaces Necklaces have no 2-set. They still take Perfect Lunasigils for stats, and they take one Radiant or Hollow Mark for a skill rewrite. Applying a Mark over another Mark replaces it Applying a Mark over a Perfect Lunasigil replaces the Lunasigil Marks can be frosted onto Enlightened world-boss and dungeon necklaces as well Discovery ships 10 Radiant and 10 Hollow Marks. Radiant leans support and defensive. Hollow leans offensive. Fusion with world-boss, dungeon, and library accessories An Enlightened Ayanad necklace or earring can be fused with existing world-boss, dungeon, and library accessories using an enchantment scroll (Dread, Salvation, Tempest, Colossus, plus Berserker, Oracle, Arcanist, and Shadow lines). Both input accessories are consumed The Enlightened Ayanad piece's grade is kept Combo effects scale from Divine upward Celestial and below keep their default effects with no improvement Library sets need ring + earring + necklace for their 3-piece bonus Exact scroll material costs will be published when the patch is live. Enlightened Ayanad Armor is not in 1.3.6 After player feedback, Enlightened Ayanad Armor will not ship in Discovery. Some unique effects originally planned for Lunasigil armor were moved onto the accessory update instead. Existing Ayanad armor is still planned to receive retroactive set-bonus adjustments in 1.3.6. Those values remain subject to feedback. The original values can be found on Enlightened Accessories Preview. The image below shows the changes that have been made based on recent feedback. Enlightened Skills Enlightened Skills are the Radiant and Hollow rewrites frosted onto Enlightened necklaces — including fused boss and dungeon necks. Only one Mark can be active at a time. Full tooltips live in the Enlightened Skills preview. See you on September 11th.

In the months since the comet passed, herders and hunters have been telling the same story. Beasts that once kept to the deep brush have started coming into the open. Boars on the green pastures of Solzreed. Grubs along the cold ridgelines of the Karkasse high country. Ants and stranger things dragging themselves out of heat-cracked desert washes after dusk. Nobody agrees on why. Some say that the land is restless while others say that the beasts can feel a fight coming and are choosing sides. What is certain is that adventurers have begun following them, looking for a companion that will stand alongside in battle against the dark forces. Taming Taming is the first custom profession that is being added to ArcheAge Classic, as part of 1.3.6 - Discovery. This profession will fall under the "Special" category, and revolve all around taming wild beasts out in the world, either using these as your own personal mounts, or exchanging them for materials used in various ways throughout the folio of crafting recipes. ▶ Watch the video Taming the Creature Tameable beasts appear as wild stragglers around Erenor. They are marked Tameable Beast. You'll find wild tameable beasts all around regions that have a climate typical for their species to live in, such as Ants in Windscour Savannah, and Jabberwocks in Hellswamp. Alongside wild, wandering tameable beasts, you can instigate one to come out of their slumber by slaughtering its own kind in one of these regions. ▶ Watch the video The Tamer's Equipment Tamer's Equipment Backpack Name Effect Greenhorn's Backpack Greenhorn's Backpack Taming Proficiency: None. ------ A rucksack of all the tools an aspiring tamer would need to wrestle in their first beast. Wrangler's Backpack Wrangler's Backpack Taming Proficiency: 80,000. ------ For someone experienced with taming beasts. Now that they aren't a greenhorn, their toolkit has been tailored for efficiency. Herdmaster's Backpack Herdmaster's Backpack Taming Proficiency: 200,000. ------ Merely for decoration, a Herdmaster could wrangle a beast into submission without any of these tools. However, there's a sense of status that comes from the way this pack sits on their back. The Tamer's backpack grants unique skills that match the beast's mood. When the beast is Scared, Soothe it to gain its trust. Should you Dance when the beast is angry or scared, they will lose trust and eventually flee. Using the wrong action at the wrong time may cause the beast to grow wary of you, making it more difficult to gain its trust. As you gain access to the more advanced sets of tools available in the higher quality of backpacks, you'll notice taming beasts becomes marginally easier. Your New Companion A tame is made up of a grade, personality, and species. Grade determines the mount's base movement speed, personality decides its 3rd, 4th, and 5th skills, and species decides its 1st and 2nd. The first two skills will stay the same across personalities, but remain unique to each mount species. The remaining three slots are randomized between either the default skill available to the species at that level, or the skill added by its personality at that level. In total, there are four personalities: Hasty, Ferocious, Resolute, and Spunky. As an example, here are the possibilities for a Hasty-personality Boar. Reminder, all grades have the same skill pool. Mount Armor Mount armor is worn in three pieces: the shaffron, the saddle, and the cannonguards. Each piece is made in three tiers, beginning with the base nameless tier, then Regal, and then Ornate. There are four variants: Swift for a mount whose arts should return more quickly, Stout for one that should stand against harm, Survey for the pack so the beast can still walk while carrying, and Support for the company around it, restoring their mana. The steel is the same from one variant to the next. What changes is the path, and with it the set. Announcement16 August 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com 1.3.6 Preview - Scythes Fourth post in our series of features on Discovery (1.3.6). Today's post presents Scythes. In Discovery, we are adding a brand new weapon type, Scythes. This is a two-handed weapon that offers Melee, Magic and Healing all wrapped up into a single weapon. Hybrid arche-types classes have always been restrictive, with some like healing/magic being simply impossible. We aim to change this, and open more options to hybrid players as a whole. Scythes The initial release of Scythes will be limited to crafted and Hasla Emerald versions. This means that on the launch of 1.3.6, you will be able to craft from Illustrious all the way to Ayanad. The Hasla Emerald Scythe also exists, and will be an option for new, returning or curious players that want to try out this new weapon type, requiring an Infused Emerald just like any other emerald weapon. The exact details of the crafted Scythe recipes will become available in 1.3.6, however you can expect them to use similar materials to other two-handed weapons such as Staves, Greatclubs or Greatswords. Weapon Stats Scythes are a brand new weapon type that will be added to ArcheAge Classic in 1.3.6. They are two-handed, and offer Melee Attack, Magic Attack, and Healing Power all on a single weapon. This type of weapon has been designed around catering to a part of ArcheAge that has always been underdeveloped, hybrid classes. Though obsidian versions of katanas and shortspears attempted to do this before, there has never been a hybrid option in the two-handed weapon types, nor for a magic and healing combination. Now, with scythes, this is possible. Scythes do come with the drawback of not offering nearly as much Melee Attack, Magic Attack or Healing Power as their dedicated options, they offer more than enough to be viable options for players looking to mix archetypes. This means, for the first time since ArcheAge Alpha, we will see healing mages roaming Erenor, alongside two-handed melees with substantial magic attack, and healing melees that are not restricted to shortspears. The following stat distribution of crafted Scythes are available: Autumn (Str, Int, Spi) Meteor (Str, Spi) Sunset (Str, Int) Meadow (Int, Spi) Wave (Int) Flame (Str) Life (Spi) To showcase the relative power of Scythes and how they fall in line with the other weapon types, here is an Epic Ayanad Autumn Scythe. The numbers shown are not showing any form of temper. Effectively, Scythes are 13% weaker than their non-hybrid counterparts. This cost in damage comes with the flexibility of being a hybrid weapon, along with a number of weapon proc abilities. Ayanad Autumn Scythe (Epic Grade) Scythe, Gear score 1010, DPS 670 +53 Strength, +44 Intelligence, +35 Spirit Weapon Proc Abilities In addition to the three types of attack or power included on Scythes, they also have weapon procs to match. Melee and Magic both have procs that are triggered when dealing damage to targets for their respective types, and Healing has a proc when healing an ally. https://patch.aa-classic.com/img/blog/scythes/temporal.mp4 "Lifesteal" - On Damage (Melee) The wielder of the scythe heals themselves for (50 + 180% Healing Power) once on dealing melee damage. This skill is influenced by healing critical rate, critical bonus and percentage increases. Chance on Hit: 20% Cooldown: 30s "Timewarp" - On Damage (Magic) The wielder of the scythe has their Sorcery cooldowns completely reset, allowing full use of their magic arsenal again. This skill can proc from any magic damage, include damage over time effects. Cooldown reduction does not influence this proc ability's cooldown. Chance on Hit: 5% Cooldown: 180s "Infusion" - On Heal (Healing) The wielder of the scythe is filled with a mana infusion, restoring an average of 1130 mana to the player. This effect does not interrupt any ongoing effects or abilities such as Perform-tagged skills. Chance on Heal: 15% Cooldown: 45s Beyond 1.3.6 - Discovery Discovery is only the beginning for Scythes, with plans to bring Obsidian, World Boss and Dungeon variants of the weapon to ArcheAge Classic sometime in the relatively near future past 1.3.6. There will be a number of paths for the Obsidian Scythe to go down, Scythes added to dungeon loot pools, and even Scythes added to existing and new World Bosses. We are excited to continue expanding upon this weapon type. We will also be making necessary adjustments to the weapon type to ensure it is a viable option for players pursuing hybrid-archetype characters. After the release, we will be keeping an eye on the performance of the weapon type to deliver on this. Q. What material type are Scythes for crafting? What wisps and proficiency will they use? A. The exact details of the crafted Scythe recipes will become available in 1.3.6, however you can expect them to use similar materials to other two-handed weapons such as Staves, Greatclubs or Greatswords. Q. How long will we have to wait for Obsidian versions? A. We will be evaluating how long 2.0's development cycle will take, and from there we will decide whether to include an expansion to the available scythes before or after that. It will be a priority for us in the near future though. Q. Can I swap my weapon to a scythe to try it out? A. Hasla Emerald Scythes will be available on release, but there will be no other mechanism for you to turn your current weapons into scythes. Everyone will have to craft their own Ayanad versions if they want to go with it. Q. Why does the magic proc only reset Sorcery? Why not all magic skillsets? A. Sorcery was just the starting point for us, and we will see what classes people come up with to play with scythes. Potentially more skillsets could have their cooldowns added to the proc, depending on how the weapon type's balance shakes out on live ArcheAge Classic. Q. Was your question not answered here? A. Please leave your question or feedback in our Discord and we'll try our best to get back to you! We plan on having an official thread up, just like the other blog posts.

Update13 August 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com Voice Chat Beta ArcheAge Classic will soon feature a Voice Chat System! Here are all the details regarding it. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zk67_OMvOXs In-Game Voice Chat Voice Chat brings real-time communication directly into ArcheAge Classic. Talk naturally with players around you using Proximity Voice, or communicate with your entire group through Party & Raid Voice, regardless of distance. Each channel has its own volume, Push-To-Talk keybind, and Deafen control, giving you full control over what you hear and when you speak. The Voice Chat HUD displays who's currently talking and lets you mute individual players or click on their name to adjust their volume independently. Everything is integrated directly into the game, with no external software required. Voice Chat is currently available as an experimental beta feature and can be enabled or disabled at any time through the game settings. Frequently Asked Questions Q. What are the default keybinds? A. The default keybinds are B for Team Voice and ; for Proximity Voice. Q. Will Proximity Voice work in Dungeons and Arenas? A. Proximity Voice will NOT be enabled in Dungeons or Arenas. However, Party/Raid Voice works regardless of your location, making it ideal for these scenarios. Q. What is your data retention policy regarding what people say through Voice Chat? A. Voice data is not retained. Audio is transmitted to the relevant players in real time and is not persistently stored after transmission. Q. Is there a Priority Speaker system? A. Not yet, but it's near the top of our list of requested features. Q. What if someone abuses Voice Chat? A. First, mute them. This will save your ears. Second, we will be dealing incredibly harshly with Voice Chat abuse: Permanent Voice Chat ban: No longer able to speak or hear any Voice Chat. Permanent Text Chat mute: FAFO. Q. Why "Beta"? A. This is still an experimental feature. While we are confident things will go smoothly, should major issues be encountered we are reserving the ability to fully turn off Voice Chat during this beta phase. Q. When will it be available? A. Voice Chat will be available on ArcheAge Classic starting August 14th, after the weekly maintenance.

Today's post presents Enlightened Ayanad accessories and more. In the upcoming 1.3.6 patch, Ayanad accessories can be upgraded to Enlightened Ayanad Accessories through the power of Runestones. Runestone Talisman A stone etched with a powerful runic symbol. The energy of the rune pulls you towards the Ayanad Library. The scriptures in the Ayanad Library had once mentioned how Rowan Alexander had spent years of research into runestones that could be embedded into accessories to transcend its abilities. A power that could even rival the gods, Alexander destroyed the entirety of his research once Kyrios sought the power for himself. Spend 10 labor to unlock the secrets of Ayanad. Runestones were discovered by the scholars of the Ayanad Library and were once researched and used by Alexander in pursuit of great power capable of unlocking the hidden potential of items. Runestones resonate with the magic sealed within an item, drawing its dormant power to the surface. When applied to an Ayanad accessory, the Runestone breaks through the limitations placed upon its enchantments, allowing the accessory to manifest abilities previously beyond its reach. The process does not replace the accessory's existing enchantments. Instead, it awakens and amplifies the power already contained within them, resulting in an Enlightened Ayanad Accessory. Today's post presents the new Enlightened Ayanad accessories. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gF6FJZXlsb4 In the upcoming 1.3.6 patch, the scholars of the Ayanad Library have unearthed a series of scriptures which detail extensive research into the Secrets of Ayanad. Thanks to Iseren's recent submissions related to recent comet trajectories, the scholars have discovered a potential lead which reveals how to unlock the latent power of Ayanad Armor. This method has been said to have been researched by Alexander himself as he sought to uncover the secrets of Ayanad, bringing out his vestment's true potential. Unsealing the Secrets of Ayanad Enlightened Ayanad Armor is a stat only version of Ayanad armor which does not have any set effect by default. Enlightened Ayanad Stone Shirt Cloth Armor, Gear score 372 +85 Stamina, +57 Spirit Enlightened Ayanad Flame Jerkin Leather Armor, Gear score 372 +133 Strength Its set effects are activated through the use of Lunasigils on your Costume or Underwear slots. Using a runestone, your existing Ayanad armor is transformed into its Enlightened version. This upgrade does not improve the armor itself in any way, besides enabling the use of Lunasigils to allow the player to decide the set effect that is activated. There are two types of Lunasigils: Major Lunasigil Lesser Lunasigil The Major Lunasigil applies a 7-set effect and is embedded onto your Costume slot. The Lesser Lunasigil applies a 4-set effect and is embedded onto your Underwear slot. The effects of either a Major or Lesser Lunasigil will only be activated granted that you have enough Enlightened Ayanad armor pieces equipped. To activate a Major Lunasigil, you must be equipped with at least seven (7) of any Enlightened Ayanad armor pieces. To activate a Lesser Lunasigil, you must be equipped with at least four (4) of any Enlightened Ayanad armor pieces. Lunasigils can only be activated by Enlightened Ayanad. Applying another lunasigil on an existing lunasigil effect will replace it. The total number required can be activated by any stat Enlightened Ayanad, allowing the player to equip combinations such as: Example Set 1: Flame x2, Gale x2; activates 4-set Enlightenment Example Set 2: Wave x3, Earth x3, Lake x1; activates 4-set and 7-set Enlightenment Lunasigil Set Effects Enlightened Ayanad Lesser Sigils Name Effect Wave Sigil +2 Max Abyssal Charges Ocean Sigil Post Mana Regen +85 Lake Sigil Decrease Cast Time −5.7% Meadow Sigil Max Mana +2400 Stone Sigil Max Health +1500 Earth Sigil Received Healing +12.6% Gale Sigil All Crit Rate +3.3% Flame Sigil All Crit Damage +16.6% Desert Sigil Parry Rate +5.5% Squall Sigil Phys/Magic Pen +1500 Lightning Sigil Attack Speed +12.0% Typhoon Sigil Evasion +5.5% Sunset Sigil Magic Defense +2100 Quake Sigil Shield Block Rate +5.5% Life Sigil Faelight - Healing a target below 25% health with Antithesis activates Faelight. Media Blogpost #2 The next blog post will cover scythes in detail and showcase some of the items that you can expect from Primal Anthalon should you defeat him! Developer's Notes As players have brought up a multitude of questions regarding our approach on Ayanad, this section will be dedicated to sharing our thoughts and how Enlightened came to be. The original suggestion was to address the weaker sets without changing any of the stronger sets. Why did this approach change? The weaker set changes was part of the first iteration of Ayanad changes. The players brought up three concerns with these sets: Stats Some of the stat allocations were not as popular anymore. XLGames changed how stats worked throughout the course of the game's lifetime but never addressed Ayanad keeping the same stat allocation mix, so some of the Ayanad armors sets were made for an older vision of the game. Set effects Some of the Ayanad set bonuses for 4 and 7 set bonuses were not as popular or impactful for certain set types. This contributed to some sets being less popular than others. Existing sets should not be touched We value a player's time and effort and gear balancing and changes comes with great risk. Our approach needed to consider this first and foremost so that players with existing investments can see this as an upgrade path and it does not invalidate their efforts. We iterated while keeping these concerns in mind, and we faced several challenges. The first challenge that we faced when we began reviewing Ayanad with these concerns in mind is that attempting to give favorable stats to the weaker sets simply made them similar to another set that already exists. The second challenge was that attempting to buff or address the set bonuses on certain sets caused the set to be similar to existing sets, and the bonuses had to be strictly related to the stat allocations that these armors offered. The third challenge is that in order not to affect existing players, we would need to make our approach an upgrade path from existing Ayanad rather than change existing sets. Rebalancing existing sets would risk invalidating certain armors when players had already invested into them. The result of this led us to consider a more flexible path that had been suggested previously. Stat allocations are not bound to set bonuses, which allows more freedom to decide exactly which stats that they want to have. Set bonuses are not bound to specific armor types, allowing the player to decide exactly what set bonus they want to use. A new armor set that upgrades from Ayanad and offers an advantage over existing Ayanad, giving players a new chase to look forward to. By separating the set bonuses from the stats, the decision to use a certain armor type will now be determined by the stats the player would like to see in their build, instead of whether or not the set bonus of that armor type is strong enough to use. The set bonus seperation also allows us to rebalance existing set bonuses and even add new ones without needing to carefully consider the implications of them against certain armor types. Enlightened Ayanad doesn't seem to address the weaker sets at all. If anything, players are less likely to use the actual set itself now because they don't need it for the set bonus. Enlightened Ayanad allows you to use any armor piece with each other, regardless of stat allocation. If you have 4 or 7 pieces of Enlightened Ayanad, then the set bonus effect will activate for its respective Lunasigil, giving the player finer control of what stats they want and what set bonus they want. While we agree that this doesn't necessarily make a player want to use Meadow, Ocean, or Typhoon more, it opens the options for players considerably for both the set bonuses and the stat allocations that Ayanad would otherwise restrict you into. The result of this is more set bonuses to pick from, more options to pick to build stats, and more potential options that we can offer players to explore. We also have more ideas that we wish to explore with Enlightened Ayanad, such as boss lunasigils with specific effects. Will you consider further balance to the set bonuses that are listed for Enlightened Ayanad? What about adding more options? Following the 1.3.6 patch, we will observe the balance of these options and provide changes if any of the set bonuses are too strong or too weak. Initially, we intended to provide more options for players but we decided to limit our scope and revisit more options later. The following set bonus types did not make it into Discovery: Cloud Mist Tidal Volcano With the Ayanad naming scheme and set bonus decouple, we are excited to explore ideas in the future to give Enlightened Ayanad more interesting set bonuses that players can express themselves through their 4-set and 7-set combinations. Players who have invested deeply into Tier 7 Obsidian are worried that these Ayanad progression paths will invalidate their sets and there is no point going Tier 7 Obsidian. Enlightened Ayanad remains the same item level as regular Ayanad and does not offer any advantage over Obsidian besides being able to select one 4-set and one 7-set. The difference between Ayanad and Enlightened Ayanad is a mix of quality of life and allowing the player to express their set investment by giving better options for their 4-set and 7-set. Tier 7 Obsidian will still offer higher item level and provide a better mix of stats per piece compared to Enlightened Ayanad, and therefore still remain the best in slot gear choice.

The guide is split… As a certain phoenix burns to ash (and this time doesn’t seem poised to rise again) we’re honoring its memory with a slate of changes aimed squarely at improving new-player progression. Here’s what’s coming: Adventurer’s Guide A brand-new Adventurer’s Guide menu will appear in-game, accessible from the action set in the bottom-right of your screen. The guide is split into two main sections: Adventurer’s Task List A structured list of objectives ranging from Grand to Mythic (with tasks up to Heroic available at launch). These tasks are designed to gently guide new players as they step into the vast world of Erenor. Each task grade rewards an item box to help players push their adventure forward and gain momentum early on. Guides A curated list of guides written by both the team and the community, helping players better understand how the game works. Think of it as a compact, in-game wiki. Note: This list is not final and will continue to grow. At launch it focuses primarily on in-game events, but future additions will cover systems like Stats Migration, major boss mechanics, and more. :fire: Phoenix Ashes A new currency enters the world: Phoenix Ashes. This will run for 2 weeks! How to earn them Divine Clock: Earn 3 Ashes per day, at a rate of 1 per hour played. Greater Howling Abyss (GHA) – New Quest Kill Musperosa with a Mentor/Mentee pairing. This quest requires an Ancestral 7 player to bring along a lower-level player into the dungeon. Use this as an opportunity to: Make new friends Learn (or teach) dungeon mechanics Find potential guildmates Gear up newcomers with useful dungeon drops While loot distribution remains up to the group, we kindly ask veterans to extend a helping hand—letting newer players take armor pieces can make a huge difference early on. What Phoenix Ashes can be used for Enhanced Flamefeather Glider A powerful glider inspired by a certain mythical bird. Mount: Phoenix Phish This fish… swims. Divine Aria’s Weapon Autograph Instantly obtain a Divine Mistsong T1 weapon, or try your luck regrading it into Epic or Legendary. Celestial Aria’s Armor Autograph Build a Celestial Mistsong armor set as you farm Divines and beyond in dungeon runs. Pro tip: If you drop a Divine GHA piece, you can regrade your Celestial Mistsong one :wink: Bound Regrade Materials To ease regrade costs, bound scrolls will also be available through the Guide and via Ashes. Swirling Meadow – Expansion The Swirling Meadow new-player housing area will be expanded to accommodate even more players.Landrush timing: To be decided -> Will be in patchnotes tomorrow. Our goal is to help new players secure their first foothold and get up to speed for the long journey ahead. Further Catchup Guild EXP daily cap increased, making it easier for large and active guilds to level. Auroran Synthesis Materials (used for cloaks) now grant more experience per shard/stone. :shield: Large Guild Welcome Boost With several larger guilds joining and spending early guild EXP on lower levels, we’re offering a small boost: Guild leaders of Level 1–3 guilds with 50+ members may submit a ticket to receive an instant boost to Level 4. From ashes come new beginnings. See you in Erenor.

We’ll start with a small dev blog entry, followed by some important announcements about upcoming content. --- 🔧 The Journey Towards Map Editing As many of you know, one of our long-term goals has been to ex… Newsletter – May 2025 Hello everyone! In today's newsletter, we’re excited to share some major developments for ArcheAge Classic. We’ll start with a small dev blog entry, followed by some important announcements about upcoming content. 🔧 The Journey Towards Map Editing As many of you know, one of our long-term goals has been to expand the continents of Erenor. While it was technically possible for us to add new content through instances or isolated islands, we chose not to — our goal was always to expand the actual world itself, not just add disconnected zones. Until now, editing the main world map was considered out of reach due to the lack of proper tools. Today, we’re proud to announce that this is no longer the case. After months of research and development, we’ve successfully figured out how to edit the world of Erenor directly. This was a deeply complex and technical challenge involving the reverse-engineering of the game’s map format and converting it into something we could meaningfully work with. This milestone unlocks the possibility of custom zones, environmental changes, and more immersive world updates in the future. ▶ Watch the video An early "slideshow" of the map editing restoration process 🌾 New Zone: Swirling Meadow Thanks to our new mapping capabilities, we’re fast-tracking the release of a new area we’ve been working on: Swirling Meadow. The zone will release next week. 📍 Location: South of Hellswamp 🏠 Purpose: A small, focused zone aimed at new player housing, giving fresh arrivals a fairer shot at land ownership. ⚙️ New Mechanic: The mysterious Altar of CENSORED — discover its purpose when the zone goes live! (⚠️ see below) ⚠️ Please note: this zone will not be launching in its final state. While we have additional polish and content planned, the sharp influx of new players made it clear that we needed to prioritize housing access. We hope you’ll understand this tradeoff — it’s a strategic decision for the long-term health of the server. </img> 🌠 Coming Soon: Starfall – Discovery As previously announced, our next major update will be Starfall: Discovery. This patch will: Deepen the lore surrounding the comet fragments striking Erenor Rework some of the comet landing mechanics Introduce changes to Ayanad gear and accessories Feature new content we’re keeping under wraps… for now 👀 Stay tuned — we’ll be revealing more about Starfall: Discovery in the weeks to come. 🧡 Closing Note Thanks again for being part of the ArcheAge Classic community. One major feature is still under wraps, and several s… Patch 1.3.5 Preview — Starfall: Landing The ArcheAge Classic team is excited to introduce the beginning of the Starfall update series. Launching Friday, April 11, this is the first of four patches that will carry players through the Starfall saga. Here's a look at what’s coming in Patch 1.3.5, Starfall: Landing. Note: This preview does not cover the entire patch. One major feature is still under wraps, and several smaller changes will also be included at launch. 🌠 A Comet Passes Over Erenor Beginning with this update, a mysterious celestial body will pass over Erenor—bringing chaos and opportunity in equal measure. Starfalls will occur across the world, triggering PvE encounters wherever they strike. Once the meteors cool, they become valuable harvesting sites where players can gather rare materials and Comet Fragments. Lucky adventurers may even discover a powerful new weapon: the Comet Shard Staff. A new NPC, Iseren, arrives to help unravel the comet's mysteries. She’ll first appear during the inaugural cometfall on Saturday, April 12, and later set up a permanent base where players can accept quests and craft exclusive new items. 🛡️ Gear Updates Patch 1.3.5 brings highly anticipated changes to gear progression: Obsidian Transmuters are here! These items allow players to reroll Tier 7 and Tier 6 Obsidian equipment into another item of the same category—at a cost. Ayanad Gear sees quality-of-life improvements: Acid Gobbets and Armor Scraps are now tradable, making it easier to work toward Erenor Lunafrosts. Several Lunafrost effects have also been buffed to better support diverse builds and roles. 🌊 Ocean Adjustments The seas see some minor, but meaningful, changes: Leviathan's Friday spawn has been moved to Saturday, allowing players to stack it with the Abyssal Attack for a valuable buff. A new weekly Activity Token quest has been added for the Delphinad Ghost Ship. Simply complete the “Defeat the Delphinad Ghost Ship” quest to earn progress. Morpheus the Forsaken now comes with a 4-hour timer. If not defeated in time, he will retreat for 8 hours and reward nearby pirates for the interference. 🔭 What’s Next? Starfall: Landing is only the beginning. The comet’s story will unfold over three more content updates, introducing new quests, systems, and encounters—all leading to a grand finale you won't want to miss. Next up: Starfall: Discovery Starfall: Expedition Stay tuned—and get ready for an unforgettable journey through the stars. See you in Erenor soon!

h: The Research Continues, Pioneering into the Future
A Note from Ollo Research Institute
x: Announcement27 November 2024·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com A New Discovery: Dawnsdrop Tools A New Discovery: Dawnsdrop Tools The Ollo Research Institute has reached a fascinating new discovery in their studies about the effects of various materials that are combined with Archeum. The study reveals that the effects seen were stronger with higher quality of materials, leading to unstable yet unique item propert… A New Discovery: Dawnsdrop Tools The Ollo Research Institute has reached a fascinating new discovery in their studies about the effects of various materials that are combined with Archeum. The study reveals that the effects seen were stronger with higher quality of materials, leading to unstable yet unique item properties. The research has reached several communities in Ynystere and Halcyona who have requested additional help from renowned gatherers to refine and test their understanding of this new discovery. Dawnsdrop Pickaxe The Ynystere community has reported interesting effects when imbuing Archeum into pickaxes. The effects have been reported to strengthen its efficiency and increase overall output. However, this has also been reported to increase fatigue, leading to workers requesting more frequent breaks. Dawnsdrop Watering Can The Halcyona communities have also been imbuing Archeum into their own tools. ln initial reports reports, studies have shown that refining a watering can with Archeum had shown no improvement. Gatherers using the tool had then noticed later that the tool had infinite water which has caused research to surge forward as they analyzed their new findings. Further research has confirmed that refining the tool will increase efficiency and water output. The Research Continues, Pioneering into the Future Several notable communities have taken note of the accomplishments in Ynystere and Halcyona and have begun their own research into further tool advancements, such as: Dawnsdrop Pitchfork Dawnsdrop Vial Dawnsdrop Hammer Dawnsdrop Shears Dawnsdrop Quill A Note from Ollo Research Institute The Dawnsdrop tools that we're introducing in patch 1.3.2 will be the first step to bring gatherers and crafters progression based tools that benefit the profession in a unique, special way. Each tool will have their own unique quest chain story, where the player will be asked by a profession expert for help with testing and progressing the tool they're researching. The NPC will help you progress your tool steadily by asking you to do certain tasks such as gather or just simply use your tool like you do every day. The maximum grade that the tools can be progressed tomorrow will be Celestial. This will be steadily increased up to the Mythic grade. The effects of each Dawnsdrop Tool will also increase per grade, rewarding the player for reaching major goals such as epic, legendary, and mythic. The effects provided by these tools will benefit the profession in a notable way that investing into them will feel rewarding and worthwhile. Each quest objective will be increasingly difficult, requiring the player to invest in long term progression. The Watering Can is the only exception at this moment as we didn't want to conflict with the potential of farming effects and also gathering effects, so this was made as a way to water your plants easily and the quest is more fun than difficult. Which tool would you guys like to see Ollo Research Institute bring next?

Patch 1.3 is what players know as "Erenor Ete… Public Test Server for 1.3 and Release Hello everyone, As mentioned in this week's maintenance post, we've been working on towards the upcoming patch 1.3 and we'd like to share the current status of this major patch and what you can expect in the coming weeks. What is 1.3 ? Patch 1.3 is what players know as "Erenor Eternal" or "3.5", but with our own custom changes addressing the concerns that players have had with it. It will not include Cargo packs, Eternal grade, and Erenor is still being discussed internally / prompting player opinion before it is included. Sunday, September 22: We will be enabling several vendors for everyone to have fun with whacky and creative builds. h: Celebrating a year of adventures: A Message from The Darus
x: Announcement4 August 2024·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com AAClassic - One Year Anniversary AAClassic - One Year Anniversary Celebrating a year of adventures: A Message from The Darus Hello everyone, Today marks a huge milestone in our beloved project: Its first anniversary. It has been one incredible year since we've embarked on this project together. From the very first day, you guys have made this server a… AAClassic - One Year Anniversary Celebrating a year of adventures: A Message from The Darus Hello everyone, Today marks a huge milestone in our beloved project: Its first anniversary. It has been one incredible year since we've embarked on this project together. From the very first day, you guys have made this server a special place among the ArcheAge world. Your passion, dedication and love for the game have shaped Classic into a truly special server. As we celebrate our first anniversary, let's take a moment to reflect on our achievements, share some exciting news and look forward to the future! A Whole Year: Highlights 1. Launch Day On this day last year, we opened the gates to our vision of Erenor. We welcome an overwhelming amount of players. The launch was difficult: We ran into many crashes, we had huge performance issues. Luckily only 2 days later we were able to fix the performance issues and finally let the server run the way we envisonned it. At that time, we experience an outpour of love and support that truly got all of our team addicted to this project. Unforgettable memories were made then and set the tone for the year to come. 2. Custom Updates Throughout the year we have been pushing custom updates to try and make AAClassic truly unique. From features such as replanting to new boats and events, we've tried to provide players with fresh content and a game to enjoy at the deepest level. The community's feedback has been invaluable in shaping our decisions and we are thankful we had so many players willing to spend hours to help us make the best server we can Looking Ahead: What's coming next 1. Player-made Addons We have been working on publishing an Addon API for players to extend upon the game's UI. This means adding a lot of flexibility and new features, some things previously never thought possible. We hope this brings another level of customization to ArcheAge Classic. Internal tests have shown very promising addons and some community members were given early preview to help us make the Addon API as expansive as possible. With patch 1.2.17, we'll be enabling the addon system for players to using & creating. This comes next maintenance, on the 7th of August! If you're curious about the capabilities of addons, here is a small list of possibilities: Buff Alerts DPS Meter Tradepack Turn-in Counter Korean Font on Damage numbers In-world Symbols Saving Raid Roles And so much more! We're excited to see what you guys come up with. The Addons and Addons-Dev-Chat channel on Discord are now accessible, with a tutorial and some example addons. {.article-img-lg} 2. Patch 1.3, also known as 3.5 This one has been in the works for a while now. We've been working on it for a long time and the Public Test Server should be opening up soon! We hope to have a full release of 3.5 before the end of the Summer, if everything goes right during testing. {.article-img-lg} 3. The Way Ahead Some of you may wonder what the plans are past 1.3, to which we answer: Wait and See! We have two major custom patches planned, going over some dearly loved content, ravamping or expanding it. We want to keep working on what makes ArcheAge shine and we're excited to move forward and tell you more about our plans in the coming months. Thank you As we celebrate the first year of Classic, we want to extend our deepest gratitude to each and every one of you. Your support and ethusiasm towards Classic have been the driving force behind our success. Here's to another year of the game we all love so dearly, to the adventures, the friendships and conflicts that create this amazing game. Together we'll continue to make this server the best place to play ArcheAge. On that note, make sure to check your website profile, a small gift is waiting for you! Happy Anniversary! -- Aguru, Owner of ArcheAge Classic

x: Announcement22 June 2024·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com June Newsletter June Newsletter Hello everyone! A ton of things are happening soon and we wished to post a small newsletter as I'm sure everyone would love to hear about what's coming soon to ArcheAge Classic! Bidding Farewell to Retail ArcheAge As you all probably know, KakaoGames will be shutting down Retail ArcheAge NA/EU on the 27… June Newsletter Hello everyone! A ton of things are happening soon and we wished to post a small newsletter as I'm sure everyone would love to hear about what's coming soon to ArcheAge Classic! Bidding Farewell to Retail ArcheAge As you all probably know, KakaoGames will be shutting down Retail ArcheAge NA/EU on the 27th of June. While private servers are still around, the end of "official" ArcheAge is still a moment some of us may feel sad about. It feels like the end of an era, it's the end of a game everyone here loved, met friends and foes on, and made great memories on. On behalf of the Daru team, I thank all the publishers who've brought ArcheAge to our regions, through your rights and your wrongs, you allowed us to experience the best MMO there ever was. We will do our best to carry on the legacy of ArcheAge as we believe it should have evolved, and we welcome all players who join us here once Retail goes on a forever-maintenance. Progress towards Patch 1.3.0 Patch 1.3.0 is progressing well! For those who do not know, Patch 1.3.0 is the ArcheAge Classic's spin on what patch 3.5 was on retail. In our spin of this patch, we've let the community vote and thus features such as the Cargo System, Erenor Gear and Eternal Grade will not be enabled. Most players feel this is where ArcheAge started to go wrong, and we plan on fixing those wrongs. We'll post a lot more about 1.3.0 in the coming weeks as we will first enter a Public Test Server phase, with the patch up so players can experience it again and help us find bugs & gameplay imbalances. Once this PTS phase ends, we'll gear up towards a proper release of the patch! July Event Schedule Because we're nearing the end of June, we wanted to give you a sneak peek at the event schedule for July since it's pretty packed! Event Weekend - 6/27 to 7/1 Here's what you'll be able to find next weekend, as a form of farewell to Retail ArcheAge and a welcome to everyone who may move over: The Divine Blessings event will be extended by a week Experience is doubled over its usual rate ⚔️ Honor and 🍀 Vocation are both doubled over their usual rate 💰 Coinpurse and Crate drops are doubled in quantity 🛡️ Guild Experience and Prestige is doubled (from quests only) 👨‍👩‍👧 Family Experience is doubled Rum Runner Rapids - 7/3 to 7/17 The very dearly loved Rum Runner Rapids event will make a return in July! For the first half of July, you'll be able to find all the event related activities and rewards in Rookborne Basin. Time to barrel down the river! ArcheAge Classic One Year Anniversary - Phase 1 - 7/21 to 8/4 A custom event is planned to celebrate the one year anniversary of our beloved server. The first phase will focus around helping the Darus prepare the anniversary, with a daily quest during these 2 weeks and some increased activity rewards. Once this phase ends, the celebration will begin on the 4th of August! See you all very soon, we're excited to start this summer off with a bang 🎉

As part of our effort to bring great and fun content to our playerbase, we would like to introduced a new in-game activity: Supplying the Settlers This event will center around bringing Food Supplies to Auroran Settlers, to ensure the conquest of Auroria can keep going at maximum efficiency! This materializes with the arrival of a group of Sushi Chefs on the three Freedich Outposts. These Chefs will have a small mission for you... Bringing the Ice The Sushi Chefs will bring along a few boxes waiting to be filled with Ice. Players will have to figure out how to obtain some \[Pure Ice Pack]s to bring them down to the Ice Boxes and fill them up. Bringing a \[Pure Ice Pack] will have the Sushi Chef reward you with a small amount of \[Lord's Pence] {.article-img} Sashimi? Once an Ice Box is filled, the Sushi Chef will be able to prepare Fish Fillets! At this stage of the event, you'll need to go out to Sea and sportsfish! The Sushi Chef will trade any Saltwater Fish for 1 [Fish Fillet] and any Gargantuan Saltwater Fish for 2 [Fish Fillet]s With the Fish Fillet in your possession you'll then be able get some Ice at a filled \[Icebox], to obtain a \[Fish Food Supplies Pack] {.article-img} Feed the Settlers Now the final step: Bring the \[Fish Food Supplies Pack] to one of the Auroran Settlements! The pack exchangers are located near the Enoans of each Auroran zone. Once you turn in Food Supplies, like a resource tradepack, you will receive a set amount of \[Lord's Pence], influenced by the percentage of the zone you are trading with. {.article-img} Conclusion We hope this event will bring some dynamic, small scale PvP that ArcheAge excels at. As a last note, the Sushi Chef will work similarily to the Gold Trader and will only be present during certain timeslots of the day! You'll be able to help the settlers in patch 1.2.10, slated for release on the 12th of June!

Update8 May 2024·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com Patch 1.2.4 Patch 1.2.4 Hello everyone, today's patchnotes are below. What this means is that you can still expect small patches & marketplace updates every week, but we'll be hold… Patch 1.2.4 Hello everyone, today's patchnotes are below. We'd like to add that we'll be doing a small change in how we work to make it more productive on our end: We will be switching to a 2 week patch cycle. What this means is that you can still expect small patches & marketplace updates every week, but we'll be holding off bigger changes to release in batches every 2nd week. So consider this week the first of this cycle, and next week should be an update with a bit more content. The reason of this change is to increase productivity: Patching every week comes at a higher "process cost" which eats away at precious dev time. By having only small patches every second week, we have more time to do development. We also ask that you do not expect huge custom patches in the coming weeks as a lot of work is going towards 1.3. We still have some nice things planned before then 🙂 The Berserker's Hunger buff now only work on Player kills without Rebirth Trauma The Berserker's Hunger healing has been reduced to 0.65% per kill The item level of the Berserker Weapoons has been increased to 59. This puts them in line with Obsidian Tier 6. The icon for the Berserker Weapons in the Item Guide has been updated Increase the number of packs needed for the Veroe Harvest Festival from 60 to 80 A new system has been put in place to prevent players from using portals while on Rebirth Trauma during the Golden Plains Battle and the Veroe Harvest Festival Ser Meatball's skills have been updated to have full snowlion mount skills. Labor costs and fishing rod crafts have been fixed. Missing recipe for Sirensong and Andelph rudder designs using schematic scraps has been added. Hellkissed crafting recipes have been added for sunlight archeum essence. The Ultimate Fishing Rod Design can now be crafted with 60 Fisher King Coin. These can be acquired via the Mirage Isle Fishing Tournament Vanity petarmor has been fixed. Gallant mount movement speeds have been increased to 11.5 m/s. Few VFX fixes
